sentences.en: His explanation was so unclear that I don't understand it.
sentences.zh: 他的解释如此不清楚，以至于我完全不明白。

sentences.en: It's unclear if they love each other or not.
sentences.zh: 他们是否彼此相爱还不清楚。

sentences.en: The meaning of the word "sex" is often unclear.
sentences.zh: 单词“sex”的含义常常不明确。

phrases.zh: 接下来要做什么还不清楚

senses.zh: 不清楚的，模糊的；含糊的，不明确的；难以理解的
